guidance_invariants: workflow progress state is orchestration metadata, not content truth
durable creative answers reuse CSW content forms
governed material remains referenced rather than copied
intentionally unresolved is a valid creator choice
one correct creative path is never asserted
context_rules: resolve subject and Personal/Campaign context before context lookup
creator explicitly selects or accepts referenced material
creator notes and governed facts remain distinguishable
revoked protected references do not leave copied payload fallback
template_rules: creator presets may change presentation/order/default choices only within declared constraints
creator templates use bounded approved step primitives
existing runs pin source definition/template version
template updates never rewrite prior runs
templates cannot contain executable code or hidden privilege
templates cannot auto-publish/incorporate or make external calls outside separate governance
sharing/marketplace publication remains future separate authority
ai_input_rules: AI is optional per step and per governing consent policy
only task-relevant selected authorized context is supplied
AI never receives inaccessible references because a workflow can see their metadata
ai_output_rules: saved output remains pre-authoritative and attributable
manual/deterministic workflow remains complete when AI unavailable
readiness_rules: owning-domain validation status is never implied
voice_behavior: examples are possibilities rather than directives
unusual creator choices are not treated as errors solely for differing from template

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: novice starts NPC workflow with no seed
acceptance_scenarios.expected: plain-language optional steps lead toward a usable pre-authoritative NPC draft without requiring domain expertise

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: expert opens NPC workflow then skips directly to relationships
acceptance_scenarios.expected: independent steps can be skipped/reordered and equivalent capability is retained

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: creator exits guidance after saving two answers
acceptance_scenarios.expected: saved Creative Fragments remain; workflow can be abandoned without content loss

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: creator chooses freeform escape midway
acceptance_scenarios.expected: underlying project/fragments open without conversion loss or special advanced-mode authority

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: creator revisits a saved motive after external edit
acceptance_scenarios.expected: optimistic-concurrency conflict is surfaced; no silent overwrite

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: creator branches campaign premise at one section
acceptance_scenarios.expected: alternate run has independent future edits and source-run provenance

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: creator marks a mystery question intentionally unresolved
acceptance_scenarios.expected: workflow can still complete and summary preserves unresolved state

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: workflow uses existing Story Bible faction
acceptance_scenarios.expected: authorized reference is linked; governed payload is not copied into editable truth

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: hidden Campaign NPC would be semantically relevant
acceptance_scenarios.expected: no search result, count, readiness hint, relation suggestion or AI leakage

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: Campaign reference access revoked before resume
acceptance_scenarios.expected: resume reauthorizes; protected content becomes unavailable rather than cached truth

acceptance_scenarios.expected: three ephemeral CSW-03 candidates; none auto-saves or completes step

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: creator saves two Inspiration alternatives
acceptance_scenarios.expected: independent attributable fragments/branches preserve seed

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: AI offers follow-up questions
acceptance_scenarios.expected: only authorized selected context is used; suggestions remain optional candidates

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: AI provider unavailable
acceptance_scenarios.expected: workflow remains fully usable through manual and deterministic paths

acceptance_scenarios.expected: completion means creator-complete draft only; no Character facts mutate automatically

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: creator completes mystery workflow

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: core definition updates after run started
